info.name: FloorballMatch
info.description:
Collection for creating floorball matches with events and completing them

## Prerequisites:
- Backend API must be running on localhost:8080
- Teams must exist in database (run the Clubs.json collection first)
- Teams must have players assigned to them

## Usage Instructions:
1. First run 'Setup' folder in order:
   a. 'Setup Division' - finds existing division or creates one automatically
   b. 'Get Existing Season' - fetches an existing season to use for matches
2. Run the 'Completed Matches' folder to create 5 different match scenarios:
   - Match 1: Amsterdam Lions Pride vs Barcelona Eagles Condors (3-2 OT) - June 2026
   - Match 2: Barcelona Eagles vs Berlin Thunder (1-2 SO) - July 2026
   - Match 3: Milano Dragons vs Paris Wolves (4-1) - August 2026
   - Match 4: Amsterdam Lions vs Stockholm Vikings (0-1) - September 2026
   - Match 5: Dublin Shamrocks vs Vienna Hawks (6-4) - October 2026
3. Each match includes realistic events like goals, penalties, assists
4. Use 'Queries' folder to verify the matches were created correctly

## Automatic ID Fetching:
This collection uses pre-request scripts to automatically fetch:
- Team IDs from existing teams in the database
- Player IDs for each team (up to 3 players per team)
- Fallback IDs if teams/players don't exist

The collection will work consistently across different environments as long as the required teams exist.

## Match Features:
- Different penalty types: Minor, Major, Misconduct, Technical
- Power play goals and regular goals
- Overtime and shootout scenarios
- Various score lines and match patterns
- Realistic timing and period distribution
